name: dotnet-msix
Packages MSIX apps: package creation, signing, Store submission, App Installer sideloading, auto-update, multi-arch bundles, CI/CD MSIX build steps.

MSIX packaging pipeline for .NET desktop applications: package creation from csproj (`WindowsPackageType`) and WAP projects, certificate signing (self-signed for development, trusted CA for production, Microsoft Store signing), distribution channels (Microsoft Store submission, App Installer sideloading, enterprise deployment via SCCM/Intune), auto-update configuration (App Installer XML, version checking, differential updates), and MSIX bundle format for multi-architecture (`.msixbundle`).

Version assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+ (current stable). Windows 10 build 19041+ minimum for MSIX with Windows App SDK. Windows 10 build 1709+ for App Installer auto-update protocol. .NET 8.0+ baseline.

Package creation from csproj and WAP projects  
Certificate signing (self-signed, trusted CA, Store signing)  
Microsoft Store submission workflow  
App Installer sideloading and auto-update configuration  
MSIX bundle format for multi-architecture
